new.note: Hand-rolled crab, avocado and cucumber rolls, with soy and pickled ginger for dipping.
new.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with 3 tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tbsp sugar, then cool. Lay a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread with rice and lay crab sticks, avocado and cucumber along one edge. Roll up firmly, then slice into 8. Make 6 rolls. Serve with soy sauce and pickled ginger.
new.veg: Hand-rolled avocado, cucumber and carrot rolls, with soy and pickled ginger for dipping.

r2.make_ahead: Cook and season the rice up to 3 hours ahead, covered at room temperature; roll just before serving

steps.text: Rinse and cook the rice, then season with the rice vinegar and sugar and cool.
Cut the avocados and cucumber into long strips.
Spread rice over each nori sheet on a bamboo mat, lay crab, avocado and cucumber along one edge and roll up firmly.
Slice each roll into 8 and serve with soy and pickled ginger.
